entry_warning: SHELL_CARGO_FUSION: legitimate but atypical fusion protein; interpret assembly properties in construct context.
loading_info: ARCHITECTURE: ferritin-like (Flp) domain fused to the shell protein (EncFtn fusion-type); no separate cargo loaded via TP; forms internal Flp assemblies; ferroxidase / iron storage.
curation_source: Akita et al. 2007 J Mol Biol 368:1469-1483 (10.1016/j.jmb.2007.02.075); PDB 2E0Z; fusion-Flp review PMC9944552
curator_notes: Shell-cargo fusion, not a plain shell. T=3, 180 subunits, ~30-32 nm reported; the legacy row reports ~0.5 nm pores and pore locations at 2-/3-/5-fold-related sites.
